ride_issue.definition: Problems experienced before, during, or immediately following a specific ride (driver no-show, wrong route, pickup/cancellation disputes, vehicle cleanliness, unprofessional driver conduct, or lost personal items).
canonical_examples: Driver marked as arrived but was 3 streets away and then cancelled on me!
Left my iPhone in the back seat of a silver Toyota Camry. Need to call driver ASAP.
The driver took a massive detour adding 25 minutes to my airport trip.
ride_issue.boundary_rules: If a ride issue involves reckless driving causing acute fear, assault, or vehicle collision, it MUST be classified as safety_and_security rather than ride_issue. If a cancellation results purely in a disputed $5 fee without complaint about driver conduct, classify as payment_and_refund.

payment_and_refund.definition: Inquiries, disputes, or complaints regarding trip charges, cancellation fees, surge multipliers, tolls, refund requests, double billing, receipt delivery, or Uber Cash balance.
canonical_examples: Why was I charged a $5.75 cancellation fee when the driver was moving away?
Double charged on my credit card for trip #49281. Need an immediate refund.
Never received the email receipt for my trip from JFK last night.
payment_and_refund.boundary_rules: Disputes regarding promotional vouchers that failed to apply are promotions_and_offers unless the customer is requesting an explicit adjustment on an already-settled credit card charge.

safety_and_security.definition: Acute physical safety hazards, vehicular accidents/collisions, sexual or verbal harassment, reckless/dangerous driving, physical assault, feeling threatened, weapons, intoxication, or police involvement.
canonical_examples: The driver was speeding over 90mph, ran two red lights, and almost crashed into a divider.
Driver locked the doors, yelled obscenities at me, and refused to let me out.
Our Uber was hit by another car at an intersection and airbags deployed!
safety_and_security.boundary_rules: ZERO TOLERANCE: Always escalates with should_escalate=True and high risk score (>=0.85). Applies to both passenger experiences and third-party pedestrian/cyclist altercations involving Uber vehicles.

account_and_login.definition: Issues regarding account authentication, login failures, 2-factor authentication SMS codes, phone number/email profile updates, account suspensions/deactivations, or suspected account compromise/takeover.
canonical_examples: Not receiving the 2FA SMS code to verify my phone number on the app.
Someone hacked my account and ordered rides in another state!
My driver account has been deactivated without reason. Need to appeal.
account_and_login.boundary_rules: Routine login troubleshooting can be auto-handled via DM; unauthorized access/hack reports must be escalated immediately with should_escalate=True.

promotions_and_offers.definition: Questions, discount code failures, promotional campaign terms, Uber Rewards, referral bonus credits, or coupon invalidity.
canonical_examples: Promo code SAVE20 says expired but your promotional email states valid till Sunday.
Did not receive my $10 referral bonus after my friend completed their first ride.
How do I apply my student discount to my daily commute?
promotions_and_offers.boundary_rules: Refers strictly to discount/promo mechanics. If a promo failed and resulted in an unauthorized card charge that the customer wants refunded, treat as payment_and_refund.

other.definition: General brand feedback, praise/compliments, app feature suggestions, media/press inquiries, or general questions not mapping to the other 5 categories.
canonical_examples: Kudos to your customer support team for resolving my issue so quickly!
When is Uber expanding electric vehicle options to Austin, Texas?
Bug in the latest iOS app update: the map freezes on the home tab.
other.boundary_rules: Catch-all class. Ensure specific operational issues are not dumped here if they belong in ride_issue or payment_and_refund.

escalation_policy.fallback_template: We take this report very seriously and want to connect you with our specialized support team immediately. Please send us a direct message (DM) with the phone number tied to your Uber account and relevant trip details so we can investigate.
